UC-1145.note: A conversation whose message waits while an undo, a restore or a move holds the matter: its rail row, and the composer's working line. Replaced "Waiting for '{title}'" (rail) and "Waiting for '{title}' to finish." (U7-01, working line), which named the conversation it waited behind.

UC-1146.en: This matter's folder is being moved. Your message is queued and sends once that's done.
UC-1146.note: The card over the composer while the host holds the message for a relocate (TurnQueued.hold = relocate, #1286). Was "An undo, restore or move is changing this matter's papers. Your message is queued and sends once that's done." (first "…Your message goes once it's done."), which #1302's review ruled untrue when no hold is named; undo and restore now have UC-1263 and UC-1264.

UC-1147.en: Not sent, because you stopped it before it started. Your message is back in the box below.
UC-1147.note: The composer's working line after a Stop pressed in this window on a message that had not started: its words are back in the field, or in a new draft of the matter once the host stops listing the emptied conversation (ThreadsChanged removed). Until the next send. New: before, the message vanished with no word (Windows test, 24 Nov).

UC-1148.en: Another conversation also changed this paper; undoing takes its change away too.
UC-1148.note: Undo dialog (Versions, and Undo on the changed-paper card), the row of a paper whose FileChange.also_changed_by is not empty (15a: another conversation's overlapping answer also changed it). The paper is unticked (kept) by default, as for may_include_lawyer_edits. New.

UC-1149.en: Another conversation also changed {papers}. Undoing this takes its change away too.
UC-1149.note: The changed-paper card in the thread, under the papers, when any of its papers has also_changed_by (15a); {papers} names them. Hidden once the change is undone. New.

UC-1262.en: Waiting for another answer in this matter.
UC-1262.note: The card over the composer when the host queued the message with no hold named and behind another conversation (today's host, before #1286). Names no conversation. New (#1302 review).

UC-1263.en: An undo is changing this matter's papers. Your message is queued and sends once it's done.
UC-1263.note: The card over the composer while the host holds the message for an undo (TurnQueued.hold = undo, #1286). New (#1302 review).

UC-1264.en: A restore is changing this matter's papers. Your message is queued and sends once it's done.
UC-1264.note: The card over the composer while the host holds the message for a restore (TurnQueued.hold = restore, #1286). New (#1302 review).

UC-1280.en: This message wasn't sent. It's back in the box below.
UC-1280.note: The same line as UC-1147 when this window pressed no Stop for that message (the host ended it before it started for another reason). New (#1302 review).
